The Build orchestrator plugin's watchdog.mjs is the one build watchdog (build-watchdogs@1): an open registry of watches (WATCH = { id, label, what, schema, settings, set, scan, run }; register() adds one), one cron (axf-build-watchdog, every minute; axf-stale-watchdog retired), one pass, one caught log (watchdog-catch@1), one flat settings map, one alert path. Watches: sessions (watchdog/sessions.mjs, build-watchdog@1: stuck or killed sessions recovered or requeued), stale (watchdog/stale.mjs + stale-core.mjs, stale-status@1: builds standing in landing / fixing / merging pushed to the next action on their ladder: record-merge, land on green CI, fail, the retry ladder's next rung, escalate), rows (watchdog/rows.mjs, stale-row@1). Console: Settings → Plugins → Build orchestrator → Watchdog (Caught, Watches, Settings); REST watchdogs/*, MCP watchdogs-*, CLI axf watchdog, voice watchdogs.*; systems check item build-watchdogs.
